Another free backlink hack for your SaaS: get listed on Netlify Integrations (DR 91). Dofollow link to your site.

Here is how:
1. Apply at https://www.netlify.com/partners/
2. Build a Netlify extension
3. Get it reviewed

Partners only, not self-serve.

https://t.co/zBjczTT07K
posts.author: Rapid Indexer - Fastest Indexing Tool
posts.notes: 在 Netlify Integrations 申请 https://www.netlify.com/partners/、构建 Netlify extension、通过 review，得到 DR91 的 dofollow link。

posts.content:
Another free backlink hack for your SaaS: get listed on Craft CMS Plugin Store (DR 80). Dofollow link to your site.

Here is how:
1. Sign up at https://console.craftcms.com/register
2. Connect GitHub, add plugin
3. Submit for approval

Craft plugins only.
